_comment: Copy this file to wind_source.json and edit 'file' to point at your own ERA5 download. Run catalog_data.py to see what's in data/ and what to put here. See README.md.
_fileHelp: Path to a NetCDF file, relative to data/ (or absolute). null means no data: the server serves synthetic wind and says so.
_timeIndexHelp: Which time step to serve, 0-based, if the file holds more than one.
_spatialStrideHelp: Keep every Nth grid point in lat/lon. 2 is the default; raise it to trade resolution for speed (8 turns a ~350MB payload into ~22MB).
